name: Dodoco's Enchanted Candy
desc:
A souvenir from Klee during your time helping run the Knights' drinks stand.
"Put everything together on the alchemy table, wish for the shape you want, say Mom's magic words, and... poof! Dodoco-shaped candy!"
As expected of a creation by Ms. Alice. Even using ingredients common across Teyvat, it holds a wonderfully complex sweetness. Take a small bite, and you can almost hear the echo of a sweet magic incantation in your mind...
Unfortunately, the supply is limited. Better keep one as a souvenir!
